claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings, currently on CPAP/PSV with PEEP 8 cmH2O and FiO2 40%, and monitor respiratory mechanics and gas exchange.
Continue sedation with midazolam and fentanyl infusions, targeting light sedation (Richmond-RAS -1 to -2), and reassess sedation and delirium status.
Monitor and treat hyperkalemia: whole blood potassium elevated at 5.9-6.1 mEq/L; continue potassium-lowering measures and recheck potassium.
Monitor blood glucose closely and treat hypoglycemia; recent glucose 34 mg/dL with fingersticks 75-118; continue insulin and dextrose therapy as needed.
Replete magnesium and phosphate: magnesium 1.3-1.6 mg/dL and phosphate 1.2-1.5 mg/dL; continue magnesium sulfate and sodium phosphate supplementation.
Continue antibiotics (piperacillin-tazobactam, vancomycin, azithromycin) for presumed pneumonia, with sputum specimen already collected; reassess cultures and antimicrobial coverage.
Monitor arterial blood gases and lactate; recent pH 7.30, pCO2 47, lactate improving to 1.1 mmol/L; reassess ventilation and perfusion.
Monitor renal function and electrolytes: creatinine 1.2-1.4 mg/dL, BUN 31-34 mg/dL, sodium 132-141 mEq/L; continue electrolyte replacement and fluid management.
Provide VTE prophylaxis with subcutaneous heparin 5000 units as ordered.
Perform oral care with chlorhexidine gluconate 0.12% oral rinse and subglottal suctioning to reduce ventilator-associated pneumonia risk.
